scenes.setting: The interior of a modern, brightly lit metro train car during the daytime. Other passengers are seated in the background, out of focus.

panels.panel_visual_description: In the center aisle of a moving train, a young man (Character A) stands facing a humanoid robot (Character B). Both are holding onto a vertical grab pole. Character A looks at the robot with a questioning expression. The robot looks back at him, gesturing slightly with its left hand. The train car is clean and modern, with natural light coming from the windows, showing a blurred city view outside.

scenes.visual_description: A static medium wide shot shows Character A (a man) and Character B (a robot) talking in a metro train. A series of on-screen text captions in Tamil appear at the bottom of the screen, synchronized with the dialogue, highlighting key phrases.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character A says: இன்டர்வியூல "Myself Karthik"னு இன்ட்ரோ குடுக்கலாமா? [In an interview, can I introduce myself as "Myself Karthik"?]
Character B says: வேணாம் கார்த்திக். "Myself" அப்படின்னு ஆரம்பிக்கிறது தப்பு. "I am Karthik" இல்லனா "My name is Karthik"னு சொல்லுங்க. அதான் கெத்தா இருக்கும். [No, Karthik. Starting with "Myself" is wrong. Say "I am Karthik" or "My name is Karthik". That will be cool.]
Character A says: அட ஆமாப்பா. ஆனா எனக்கு இங்கிலீஷ் பேச வராதே. [Oh, yes. But I don't know how to speak English.]
Character B says: பயப்படாதீங்க. என்கூட தினமும்... [Don't worry. With me, daily...]
